fields.label: Route
fields.description: Optional: link a standard Route to auto-fill Origin/Destination and drive per-destination driver pay.

fields.label: Trip Type
fields.options:
Loaded Haul
Empty Return to Depot
fields.description: Loaded Haul: normal revenue trip with a customer delivery. Empty Return to Depot: repositioning an empty container back to the depot/CFS — no Delivery Note or Authority to Load is required, but an Interchange Number is required once returned. Revenue is still optional on either type (some interchange/repositioning runs are paid).

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: If this haulage is against a Sales Order for the customer, link it here to auto-fill Revenue Earned from its Grand Total. Leave blank and enter Revenue manually if there's no Sales Order.

fields.label: Delivery Note
fields.description: Generated automatically from the linked Sales Order when this trip starts (status set to Ongoing), the same way a normal Sales flow produces a Delivery Note. Leave blank to have it auto-created, or link an existing submitted Delivery Note yourself (e.g. for a partial shipment). Locked once set, and the Delivery Number captured at offload must match it. Not applicable to Empty Return to Depot trips.
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:(doc.status=="Ongoing" || doc.status=="Completed") && doc.trip_type!="Empty Return to Depot"

fields.label: Pre-Trip Fuel Log
fields.description: A Full Tank fuel log for this truck, dated on or before departure — required before the trip can start (status Ongoing). Confirms the truck was fueled up before leaving, reducing the risk of a highway breakdown from running dry. Locked once set.

fields.label: Pre-Trip Inspection
fields.description: A Pass'd Trip Pre Inspection for this truck, dated on or before departure. Optional by default; becomes required before the trip can start (status Ongoing) if Transport Logistics Settings > Require Pre-Trip Inspection Before Departure is enabled. Locked once set.

fields.label: Expected Delivery Date & Time
fields.description: Promised delivery time to the customer, if tracked. Used by the Delivery Performance report to classify a trip as On-Time or Late once offloaded. Leave blank if this isn't tracked for this trip — it won't be counted as either.

fields.label: Shipment
fields.description: Optional: link the Shipment this container belongs to, to auto-fill Container No.

fields.label: Point of Loading
fields.description: Optional: where this container/cargo was loaded (port, depot, CFS or warehouse) before this trip departed.

fields.label: Cargo Details
fields.description: Optional: description of the cargo/container contents being hauled on this trip.

fields.label: Planned Depot / Yard
fields.description: Depot, CFS or yard this empty container was originally routed to (mirrors Destination). Set automatically once this trip is saved as an Empty Return to Depot trip, and locked from then on — it's the baseline the actual return depot is compared against.

fields.label: Actual Depot / Yard
fields.description: Depot, CFS or yard the empty container was actually returned to. Can differ from Planned Depot / Yard (e.g. driver redirected to a different depot) — if it does, a reason is required.

fields.label: Returned to a Different Depot
fields.description: Set automatically when Actual Depot / Yard doesn't match Planned Depot / Yard.

fields.label: Reason for Depot Change
fields.description: Required when the container was returned to a different depot than planned — e.g. the original depot was full, closed, or redirected by the shipping line/CFS.

fields.label: Interchange Number
fields.description: Container interchange receipt number issued by the depot/CFS confirming the empty container was handed back in acceptable condition. Required once this trip is marked Returned.

fields.label: Interchange Receipt
fields.description: Scanned/photographed copy of the interchange receipt issued by the depot/CFS confirming the empty container was accepted back. Required once this trip is marked Returned.

fields.label: Guarantee Form
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.trip_type!="Empty Return to Depot" && doc.container_no && doc.offload_status=="Offloaded"
fields.description: Scanned/photographed copy of the container guarantee form, attached when this container is delivered. Required at offload once a Container No is set on this trip.

fields.label: Guarantee Form Details
fields.description: Details captured from the guarantee form at delivery (e.g. guarantor, amount, validity, container condition).

fields.label: Revenue Earned
fields.description: Auto-filled from the linked Sales Order's Grand Total. If no Sales Order is linked, enter the revenue for this trip manually.

fields.label: Driver Mileage Payment
fields.description: Auto-created as a draft when this trip starts (status set to Ongoing), for the Driver, using this trip's Route and the Route's Driver Rate — one trip's worth of per-destination mileage pay. Locked once set. Not created if no Route is linked to this trip (there's no per-destination rate to use in that case) — link a Driver Mileage Payment manually if one is still owed.

fields.label: Delivery Number
fields.description: Must match the Delivery Note recorded above (the document issued to the driver when the trip started) - transcribe it from the physical document in hand at offload. A mismatch is rejected: it means the driver is not returning proof against the original delivery. Not applicable to Empty Return to Depot trips.

fields.label: Reason for Delay
fields.description: Only relevant if this trip was offloaded later than the Expected Delivery Date & Time above.

fields.label: Proof of Delivery
fields.description: Signed delivery note / POD document confirming the client received the load. Required before a Loaded Haul trip can be marked Offloaded. Not applicable to Empty Return to Depot trips.

fields.label: Proof of Delivery Authenticated
fields.description: Set only via the 'Authenticate Proof of Delivery' action by an authorized user (Transport Manager) who has independently verified the scanned document and Delivery Number against the physical/client records. Cannot be set by the person who performed the offload.

fields.label: Driver Change Approval
fields.description: Once a trip already has a Driver assigned, swapping to a different Driver requires System Manager approval. Use the 'Request Driver Change' action instead of editing Driver directly.

fields.label: New Driver Requested
fields.description: Set by 'Request Driver Change'. Applied to the Driver field only once a System Manager approves this request.

fields.label: Manager Approval Status
fields.options:
Not Required
Pending Approval
Approved
Rejected
